description: By Buddy JerichoA few nights after the primary, we opened a Zoom call with GOP county leaders and grassroots Republicans expecting a normal campaign update.Instead, people kept joining. Questions kept coming. Some were about strategy. Some were about November. Some were about how we reach unaffiliated voters and talk to families worried about affordability, public safety, education and the direction of the state.And some were about rumors from the primary that were still alive, even after the vo
title: The Campaign After the Campaign
